intro: Discarded in the wilds of the Barrens lies an empty keg bearing the inscription of Chen Stormstout. Finding it begins a journey into the past deeds of the famed wandering brewmaster who once lent his fighting skills to the founding of Durotar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,
May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."

clips.title: Completion
paras: This was one of Chen Stormstout's kegs. He traveled with Rexxar a long time ago. I haven't seen or heard about him in a kodo's age. I appreciate you bringing this to me, friend.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
